en: Genesis 49

p.src: 1  Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

en: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.
u.src: 1  Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

p.src: 2  Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.

en: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
u.src: 2  Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.

p.src: 3  “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.

ja: ルベンよ、あなたは私の
en: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
u.src: 3  “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.

p.src: 4  Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.

ja: のように奔放なあなたは、 もはや優れた
en: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.
u.src: 4  Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.

p.src: 5  “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

en: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
u.src: 5  “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

p.src: 6  My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.

en: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.
u.src: 6  My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.

p.src: 7  Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

en: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
u.src: 7  Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

p.src: 8  “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.

ja: たちはあなたをほめたたえる。 あなたの
のうなじを押さえる。 あなたの
en: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.
u.src: 8  “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.

p.src: 9  Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

ja: 子のようにうずくまった。
こすことができるだろうか。
en: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
u.src: 9  Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

p.src: 10  The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.

ja: れない。 それが属する方が
の従順はその方のものとなる。
en: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.
u.src: 10  The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.

p.src: 11  Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

ja: を選り抜きのぶどうの
い、 その装いをぶどうの
en: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
u.src: 11  Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

p.src: 12  His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.

en: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.
u.src: 12  His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.

p.src: 13  “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

ja: 界はシドンに達するだろう。
en: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
u.src: 13  “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

p.src: 14  “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.

ja: イッサカルは骨太のろば、 鞍袋の
en: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
u.src: 14  “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.

p.src: 15  He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.

ja: が良く、 その国が麗しいのを
い、 強制労働をするしもべとなった。
en: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
u.src: 15  He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.

p.src: 16  “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

ja: く。 イスラエルの一部族として。
en: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
u.src: 16  “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

p.src: 17  Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

ja: にいるまむしとなる。 それは
en: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.
u.src: 17  Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

p.src: 18  I have waited for your salvation, LORD.

en: I have waited for your salvation, LORD.
u.src: 18  I have waited for your salvation, LORD.

p.src: 19  “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.

ja: が押し寄せる。 だが
en: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
u.src: 19  “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.

p.src: 20  “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.

en: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
u.src: 20  “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.

p.src: 21  “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.

en: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
u.src: 21  “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.

p.src: 22  “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

ja: り豊かなぶどうの木。 その
en: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
u.src: 22  “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

p.src: 23  The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:

en: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:
u.src: 23  The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:

p.src: 24  But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

ja: を帯びた。 ヤコブの力ある方の御手によって。 そこから、イスラエルの
en: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
u.src: 24  But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

p.src: 25  even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

en: even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
u.src: 25  even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

p.src: 26  The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.

ja: ぶ。 それらはヨセフの
en: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.
u.src: 26  The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.

p.src: 27  “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”

ja: ベニヤミンは貪り食う
en: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”
u.src: 27  “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”

p.src: 28  All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.

ja: である。父は一人一人を、それぞれにふさわしい
en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.
u.src: 28  All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.

p.src: 29  He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

ja: に加えられようとしている。ヘト
en: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
u.src: 29  He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

p.src: 30  in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

ja: だ。アブラハムが墓地の所有地として、ヘト
en: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
u.src: 30  in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

p.src: 31  There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

ja: そこにはアブラハムとその
られた。そこにはイサクとその
られ、そこに私はレアを
en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
u.src: 31  There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

p.src: 32  the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

en: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
u.src: 32  the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

p.src: 33  When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.

en: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.
